==> modules.mk (generated, modules-mk) <==
# modules.mk: the build units in link order and each C unit's compiler, generated by romlift.
OBJS := \
	build/rom_header.o \
	build/crt0.o \
	build/src/main.o \
	build/asm_08000104.o \
	build/src/main_2.o
C_OBJS := \
	build/src/main.o \
	build/src/main_2.o
EXPECTED_OBJS := \
	build/expected/rom_header.o \
	build/expected/crt0.o \
	build/expected/main.o \
	build/expected/asm_08000104.o \
	build/expected/main_2.o
build/src/main.o: CC1 := tools/agbcc/bin/agbcc
build/src/main.o: CFLAGS := -mthumb-interwork -Wimplicit -Wparentheses -O2 -fhex-asm
build/src/main_2.o: CC1 := tools/agbcc/bin/agbcc
build/src/main_2.o: CFLAGS := -mthumb-interwork -Wimplicit -Wparentheses -O2 -fhex-asm
# A stub put back by hand for a function the C defined: its file is under asm/matchings/ until generate runs (D111).
ROMLIFT_RESTORED := $(strip $(foreach f,$(shell sed -n 's|^[[:space:]]*INCLUDE_ASM("\([^"]*\)",[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_]*\)).*|\1/\2.s|p' src/main.c src/main_2.c 2>/dev/null),$(if $(wildcard $(f)),,$(if $(wildcard $(subst asm/nonmatchings/,asm/matchings/,$(f))),$(f)))))
ifneq ($(ROMLIFT_RESTORED),)
$(warning INCLUDE_ASM names $(ROMLIFT_RESTORED), which generate moved to asm/matchings/ when the C defined the function: run $(or $(ROMLIFT_RUN),npx romlift) generate to write it back)
endif
# make debug: the ELF with DWARF debug information for the C modules, its bytes checked against the ROM (D124).
DEBUG_OBJS := $(patsubst build/src/%.o,build/debug/src/%.o,$(OBJS))
.PHONY: debug
debug: build/debug/$(NAME).elf
build/debug/$(NAME).elf: $(ROM) build/debug/src/main.o build/debug/src/main_2.o FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sed 's|build/src/|build/debug/src/|g' ldscript.txt > build/debug/ldscript.txt
	$(LD) -T build/debug/ldscript.txt -o $@ $(DEBUG_OBJS)
	$(OBJCOPY) -O binary $@ build/debug/$(NAME).gba
	@cmp build/debug/$(NAME).gba $(ROM) || { echo "$@: its bytes are not $(ROM)'s, so its addresses are not the ROM's (-g changed the code a compiler wrote)" >&2; rm -f $@; exit 1; }
build/debug/src/main.o: CC1 := tools/agbcc/bin/agbcc
build/debug/src/main.o: CFLAGS := -mthumb-interwork -Wimplicit -Wparentheses -O2 -fhex-asm -g
build/debug/src/main.o: src/main.c FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(C_RECIPE_$(notdir $(CC1)))
build/debug/src/main_2.o: CC1 := tools/agbcc/bin/agbcc
build/debug/src/main_2.o: CFLAGS := -mthumb-interwork -Wimplicit -Wparentheses -O2 -fhex-asm -g
build/debug/src/main_2.o: src/main_2.c FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(C_RECIPE_$(notdir $(CC1)))
